settings.heading: How it works
settings.content: 1. Design it here and check the live preview and print files. 2. Add one hoodie, or switch to Whole group and add everyone with their own size and name. 3. We print exactly what you approved using durable DTF transfers on genuine AWDis Just Hoods garments.

settings.heading: Delivery & returns
settings.content: Printed in the UK and dispatched in 5–7 working days. Group orders for a whole year are dispatched together. Personalised items can't be returned unless faulty — if something's not right, we'll reprint it.

settings.heading: Sizes
settings.content: AWDis Just Hoods adult sizes are unisex — pick your usual size, or a size up for a relaxed leavers fit. College Hoodie 2.0 goes up to 5XL; Baseball Hoodie and Varsity Jacket go up to 2XL.
